summary: Frontend-only regression for the redesigned Lumen Event Management landing page (14 sections + 2 dashboards + mobile). All 15 review items from the request verified PASS with ZERO console errors and ZERO page errors. Hero rotating chip cycles every 2.2s (Tech Summits -> Music Festivals confirmed). All 6 categories render. Featured Event card shows Aurora Tech Summit 2027 with DAYS/HRS/MIN/SEC countdown blocks and 72% capacity bar. 4 upcoming event tilt cards present. How It Works steps 01/02/03 (Discover/Book/Experience) visible. Live Activity feed rotates every ~2.4s. Global Cities shows 12 city pings + ranked list. Past Events Gallery has 6 masonry items with working lightbox open + close. Testimonials prev/next cycle correctly and 4.96 score visible. Pricing shows Starter/Studio (Most popular)/Atelier. FAQ has 6 items and accordion toggles work. /dashboard and /admin routes load. Mobile (375px) hamburger toggle opens mobile menu correctly.

issues: Heading words 'Experience / Events / Like / Never / Before' use inline-block SplitReveal spans without whitespace, which on narrow screens causes each word to wrap to its own line; visually the hero becomes very tall on mobile. Consider wrapping the first line in flex-wrap or allowing natural word-spacing so 'Experience Events' can fit on 1-2 lines on mobile.

textContent of [data-testid=hero-heading] reads as 'ExperienceEventsLike Never Before' (no spaces between SplitReveal words because each word is wrapped in inline-block spans relying on right-padding for visual spacing). This is purely a testability/accessibility concern — substring assertions like 'Experience Events' fail. Consider adding a non-breaking space or aria-label for the heading.

action_items: (Optional/low priority) Make hero heading SplitReveal preserve a real space character (or aria-label) so screen-readers and automated tests see 'Experience Events Like Never Before'.
(Optional/low priority) Tighten hero heading wrapping on mobile so 'Experience Events' fits on a single line at 375px instead of stacking one word per line.
critical_code_review_comments: Architecture clean: 14 well-separated section components, all use data-testid for major elements, framer-motion animations consistent, useCountdown encapsulated.
FaqAccordion correctly uses single `open` index state so only one item can be open at a time (verified by code review; behavior is enforced by the setOpen(isOpen ? -1 : i) pattern).
Hero rotating chip uses AnimatePresence with mode='wait' and a keyed motion.span — no React key warnings observed.
LiveActivity rotation interval (~2.4s) works without console warnings.
PastEventsGallery lightbox has both data-testid='gallery-lightbox' and 'gallery-lightbox-close' — both verified clickable.
Mobile hamburger toggle (navbar-mobile-toggle -> navbar-mobile-menu) works correctly.
No R3F/three runtime errors — the CSS+SVG BackgroundAura replacement is functioning as intended.
Previously reported framer-motion useScroll non-static-container warning was not observed in this run; either resolved or non-blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend URL: https://event-flow-49.preview.emergentagent.com. Routes: / (landing with 14 sections), /dashboard (user), /admin (admin). All section data-testids confirmed present: hero-heading, hero-explore-button, hero-create-button, hero-scroll, hero-rotating-chip, hero-subheading, hero-stats, featured-event-hero (text-based lookup works), live-activity, global-cities, city-ping-*, gallery-item-{id}, gallery-lightbox, gallery-lightbox-close, testimonials, testimonial-prev, testimonial-next, faq-toggle-{0..5}, navbar-mobile-toggle, navbar-mobile-menu, landing-page, footer. Note: hero-heading textContent has no spaces between SplitReveal words ('ExperienceEventsLike Never Before'); use substring matches like 'Like Never Before' or 'Events' rather than full-phrase 'Experience Events Like Never Before'. Backend testing was skipped per request — no backend changes in this iteration.
rca of the issue: No issues to RCA — all flows green. Minor cosmetic notes only: (a) Hero heading SplitReveal does not include literal spaces between words (uses pr-[0.18em] for visual gap), which is a testability/accessibility nit. (b) On mobile 375px, the same SplitReveal causes each word to wrap onto its own line because inline-block words with right-padding don't share whitespace; a flex-wrap container or natural word spacing would fix the wrap behavior.
